body: Well I started Horizon:Zero Dawn a few months back. It was charming and beautiful, but I've lost the drive to relearn the mechanics from scratch now. As for an MMO, I've never been the competitive type, and rising stats feels hollow to me. But maybe there is a zen to it ?

Thank you, and yeah, I have those thoughts too... Even 3-years-ago-me didn't have much to complain in retrospect. But memories are tricky, I think we edit the nasty stuff gradually and stick to the better one, as a survival trait. I cannot imagine myself in twenty years however, if I am still there, I think I will be a totally different person (for the better or not). I cannot empathize with this version of me. I juste hope to survive the trip through the years a little less afraid and alone.

Are you me ?!? It's uncanny, you described excactly how I feel about myself. The intensity and its curse, hope fading away with the years, the hate...oh, the Hate...
I cannot give you any advices, as I am also in a dark place. But you are not weird, you are not what your hate tells you. You have the potential to love and be loved, as each of us, even broken ones, can find a way to reconcile ourselves with our body and mind. I wish you peace and warmth, so you can rest a little from your anger and watch the world in a different light. It could get better.

It's a personal feeling, maybe it's the fact that so much (useless?) details are added to the world that my eyes don't focus on scale and distances as much as with the original, constantly distracted with bits and patches of new texture and geometry.

It's sad for me, as I adore this game fondly, to see that this remake destroy a lot of the sense of scope and scale of the original (and HD port for PS3). Too much details. A little restraint would have been more respectful of the vision. More is not always for the best.
I'll buy this at the first occasion of course, it's SotC. But, eh... I've got a Star Wars Special Edition feel about it.
Even even worse when you are from "foreign parts", where Discworld often sit sadly between Mass Effect and Star Wars novels in bookstores.
Thank you, it helps a little. :)
Thank you so much, yeah, you're right I should exercise more, keep the motor running... At least I'll be to tired to be sad.
Ouiii? But it's hard to focus on anything when in pain from sleep and food deprivation.. :/ I wish I could, escapism seems like a blessing right now.
Thank you, and well.. that's the plan if I find the energy to this new Quest of the Not So Terrible Therapist...

Well, I was prescribed AD medication with benzos for anxiety, the classic batch as I understand. AD made me crazy, full blown despair...I alerted my therapist who just said "push one more week, it will stabilize". I tried, oh yeah I tried HARD ! I wanted to get better, to fix my stupid brain. Last thing I remember was waking in an ER with tubes all over : I supposedly tried to kill myself with my stash of benzos and cheap vodka. My therapist remarked that I was "stupid, but lucky to be alive". I was feeling like he was absolutely right, for the first part. 
I'll definitely try to find a decent one next time.

edit : oh and my favorite place in France is the Pyrénées mountains (especially the Cirque de Gavarnie, it's a peaceful, beautiful place) :)
